title: First-push-green share is measured per PR
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-16: "agenci nie znają reguł z repozytorium" — tonight most PRs needed 2-4 CI rounds on rules the repo already enforces (biome on JSON, task-quality, spec/receivers.json, shard weights, standards-proposals test, Proof `cmd: verdict`, weak-tests line).
Outcome: `krn ledger --first-push-green` prints the share of the last 50 merged PRs whose first pushed head got a green Check, and the CI rounds per PR; spec/metrics.json names it as the primary brain metric.
Proof: `node --test test/outcome/first-push-green.test.ts` passes against a verbatim gh capture.
Files: src/cli/ledger.ts, src/outcome/, spec/metrics.json
